hypothesis: At the same two synthetic curvatures, jointly optimize speed, full mechanical relative-periodicity and preclip-force/clipping/body-speed constraints. No fixed-speed post-filter or speed grid.

problem.variables: v, beta, delta, gas, four wheel omega; constant steer/gas, brake0; source4raw period including lagged offset memory
problem.bounds: v[5,90], beta +/-.6, delta +/-.4, gas[0,1], omega[0,500]. These are finite branch bounds, not physical impossibility claims.
problem.equalities: body-frame velocity difference/90, yaw difference*3.24/90, four wheel omega differences*.54/90 ==0. Other mechanical memory follows the parameterization and is independently checked, including all556signature fields.
problem.inequalities: all16 raw force ratios<=1.059; for EACH raw prefix, sorted force ratio at rank floor(.1*N)+1 from largest <=.9998 for periodic design, <=.9999 for transition, sufficient for clipping<=10% with float32 reserve; all raw hull/wheel speeds<=99.9. The .9998/.9999 clip reserves is a conservative numerical sufficient condition, not physical necessity.
problem.objectives: For each identical feasible set: first maximize v; then minimize v initialized at selected max solution. Two finite local solves, no speed grid. Feasible endpoint witnesses do not certify global extrema or every intermediate speed.
problem.initialization: One max initialization per fixture: v=.9*556speed, omega=.9*556omega, beta/delta/gas from556solution. No alternate start. Min starts at selected max witness.
problem.optimizer: SLSQP maxiter60,ftol1e-10,eps1e-7; <=700 unique source evaluations/state objective. Cache identical float64 variables across objective/constraints/Jacobian calls. Keep best evaluated feasible iterate according to fixed objective; final convergence and feasible witness are separate.
problem.feasible_numerical_gate: max scaled periodic equality<=1e-8, minimum inequality>=-1e-8; independent float32 fullstate normalized residual<=1 and original safety checks determine admitted witness. No feasible iterate means NOT_FOUND, never no safe orbit proof.

validation.independent: each selected endpoint: float32 independent4raw mechanical comparison then separate accepted4raw safety; same556tolerances and body/path/footprint/clip guards
validation.cycles: Admitted MAX witness in each fixture:8 exact cycles and8 cycles with one prescribed body-vx+.001 and rear wheel3 omega+.01 perturbation. Finite error growth diagnostic; no asymptotic stability claim. Physical/map failure stops that rollout without changing existence verdict.
validation.references: Synthetic target speed gives mechanical overspeed reference4.85; retain old551 reference overspeed as separate diagnostic. No old551 compliance, whole-road feasibility, native reachability or actual policy promotion is claimed.

transition.trigger: Both original MAX witnesses independently admitted. Multiple-period or perturbation outcomes remain separate; fresh same source MAX fixture may be used for the preregistered minimal transition.
transition.target: Next existing seed curvature after first fixture only. Maximize safe periodic speed with upper bound source MAX speed; same constrained problem, one initialization from source solution; <=700unique evaluations. No alternative curvature.
transition.control_problem: 4holds x steer/signed pedal; SLSQP min sum squared normalized fullstate endpoint errors, subject to raw force/prefixclip/body constraints throughout16raw; maxiter60/ftol1e-10/eps1e-7, <=1000unique rollouts. One linear interpolation of source/target commands.
transition.endpoint: 556transition fullstate tolerances: v.15,yaw.05,M=I*.05,joints.02,rates.15,omega.5,gas.02,heading.02,offset.15; lever1e-6/friction1e-8/constants1e-10. Select best feasible iterate; independent float32 validation then3 target holds if endpoint pass.

stop: Stop phase on finite solver cap; retain best feasible iterate and classify convergence separately. Stop whole run on deadline/body domain/global compute cap with full checkpoint. No rerun, no alternate initialization, no post-result change of gates. No feasible witness is solver/branch uncertainty, not an infeasibility certificate.
